replies.author: EinfachNalor
replies.body:
Similar to kycrafft
- to thin, you cant really tunnel
- way to much void, you need to bridge to far in my opinion and everyone who          sees  you can just shoot you off
- I dont think the gameplay will work. I guess one team takes over the middle island and then the other team is just cramped in there spawn while being spawn killed per bow. That might end up worse than being properly kill farmed on Quintus.
- I dont know how many Players you want to be te max, but i think more than 10 would be WAY to much.


Also, you made a topic about this already 2 days ago and your map was denied. Please then spam the topis again, it will just get denied again.
